T1.step: Click the grey box to choose the photo.
In the file window that opens, double-click the photo (the window is not shown here).
Click the caption box and paste the post's caption.
Read the summary at the top of the result.

T2.step: Find the first finding marked "Flag raised".
Read "What to check" in that finding.

T3.step: Click the grey box to choose the photo again.
In the file window that opens, double-click the photo again (the window is not shown here).
Click the caption box and paste the post's caption.
Click the "Date posted" box and type the date the post claims.
Find the "Recycled context" finding and read what it now says about the date.

T4.step: Click the grey box to choose the video.
In the file window that opens, double-click the video (the window is not shown here).
Click the caption box and paste the post's caption.
Click "Run audit" and wait (a video takes up to a minute).
Find the "Speech ↔ picture match" finding marked "Flag raised".
Click the moment button (▶ and a time) in that finding.
The video player has moved to that moment: watch and listen there.

T5.step: Read its explanation and the line starting "Why:".
Read "What to check yourself" below it.
